# embedded check, then catalog check; each is - (did not run), a status in hex, or status:signer
# Normal readings.
0:Example Corp / - => signed embedded Example Corp
0x800B0100 / 0:Microsoft Windows => signed catalog Microsoft Windows
0x800B0100 / 0x800B0100 => unsigned
0x800B0003 / - => unsigned
# Invalid signatures outrank an absent one and keep the signer when it was readable.
0x80096010:Example Corp / 0x800B0100 => invalid Example Corp the file was changed after it was signed (0x80096010)
0x800B0109 / 0x800B0100 => invalid - the certificate chain ends at an untrusted root (0x800B0109)
0x800B0101:Old Corp / - => invalid Old Corp the signing certificate has expired (0x800B0101)
0x800B0100 / 0x800B010C:Cat Corp => invalid Cat Corp the signing certificate was revoked (0x800B010C)
# A valid catalog beats an invalid embedded signature.
0x80096010 / 0:Microsoft Windows => signed catalog Microsoft Windows
# Partial and unavailable readings.
0x80070005 / 0x80070005 => unavailable access denied
0x80070020 / - => unavailable the file is in use
- / - => unavailable the signature check did not run
# An unknown status is reported with its code, never as healthy.
0x80091234 / - => invalid - verification failed (0x80091234)
